kicker: THE COLLEGE RITUAL THAT GOT GUYS MARRIED
title: Try to get *rejected* every Tuesday

text: A group of college friends made a rule: get turned down once a week. *Then they all got married.*

label: WEEK 1
head: Ask for 10% off your coffee
sub: Worst case: they say no and you still get coffee.

label: WEEK 2
head: Ask to skip the line
sub: Ask the person in front of you. Expect a no.

label: WEEK 3
head: Ask your boss for the big project
sub: A no costs you nothing you had.

label: WEEK 4
head: Ask her out, in person
sub: You've already survived 3 weeks of no's.

text: Every no makes the next ask *cheaper.*
